title: 第6章 捂不热，只会冻伤
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

温以染跟着傅临渊刚出大门口，一阵急促的脚步声传来，身后一声叫喊：“傅临渊！”

温以染回头，沈惊鸿提着裙摆跑过来，目光先落在温以染脸上，又转向傅临渊。

她美丽的脸有点扭曲，“我追了你三年，三年就是一块石头也该捂热了，你为什么对我这么冷淡？”

傅临渊神色冷淡：“那是你的事，与我无关，我也从未回应过你。”

沈惊鸿眼眶红了，“你就这么狠心……”

傅临渊：“你错了，我不是石头，是冰，捂不热，只会冻伤。”

沈惊鸿不甘心在他身后喊，“那她呢？她是谁？凭什么你对她这么好？”

傅临渊没回答。

坐在车上，温以染没忍住：“那女明星挺漂亮的，还追你那么久，你怎么那么对人家？”

傅临渊：“我怎么了？”

温以染：“有点冷血。”

傅临渊冷笑：“等会儿让你知道。”

温以染：“知道什么？”

一进门，温以染就彻底明白了他的意思。

傅临渊在玄关就摁着她狠狠收拾了一顿。

边收拾边问她，“我冷血吗？”

温以染喘着，依旧嘴硬，“冷，像冰柜里爬出来的。”

傅临渊冷笑，把她往上一提，让她双腿环住他的腰，“你也就嘴硬，身体比嘴诚实多了。”

“你也就这点本事，说不过就上，幼儿园毕业的？”温以染咬牙回击。

“继续”，傅临渊加快节奏，“你嘴硬一句，我多做十分钟，看谁先认输。”

温以染最后还是败下阵来，像全身瘫痪的人软在他怀里。

傅临渊靠在墙上，呼吸还没平复，“我冷血吗？”

温以染有气无力翻了个白眼，“热。跟火炉似的，行了吧？全天下就你最热。”

“阴阳怪气。”

“跟你学的。”

傅临渊把温以染抱到沙发上，转头又去了洗手间。

那些曾被他死死压在脑海深处的画面，再次闪回。

女孩穿着蓝白条纹病号服，缩在角落里，看到他猛地扑上来，死死抓住他肩膀。

瞳孔散着，声音嘶哑：“快上我…上我…”

下一秒她猛地歪过头，对着他脚边的地面剧烈呕吐。

嘴里含糊不清：“脏……好脏……”

水龙头的水还在哗哗地流。

傅临渊猛地回神，发现已经跪在了洗手台前。

这次只是干呕，并没有吐出东西。

他抬起头，看向镜子。

Page (1/3)

Just as Wen Yiran followed Fu Linyuan out of the gate, there was a rush of footsteps, and a cry from behind: "Fu Linyuan!"

Wen Yiran turned around, and Shen Jinghong ran over with his skirt in hand. His eyes first fell on Wen Yiran's face, and then turned to Fu Linyuan.

Her beautiful face was a little distorted, "I've been chasing you for three years, and it's time for you to be a stone. Why are you so cold to me?"

Fu Linyuan looked cold: "That's your business and has nothing to do with me. I have never responded to you."

Shen Jinghong's eyes turned red, "You are so cruel..."

Fu Linyuan: "You are wrong, I am not a stone, I am ice. Covering it will not heat me, I will only get frostbite."

Shen Jinghong shouted after him unwillingly, "What about her? Who is she? Why are you so nice to her?"

Fu Linyuan didn't answer.

Sitting in the car, Wen Yiran couldn't hold back: "That female star is quite beautiful, and she has been chasing you for so long. Why are you treating her like that?"

Fu Linyuan: "What's wrong with me?"

Wen Yiran: "A bit cold-blooded."

Fu Linyuan sneered: "I'll let you know later."

Wen Yiran: "What do you know?"

As soon as he entered the door, Wen Yiran completely understood what he meant.

Fu Linyuan held her down at the entrance and punished her severely.

While cleaning up, he asked her, "Am I cold-blooded?"

Wen Yiran gasped, still speaking harshly, "It's cold, like someone crawled out of a freezer."

Fu Linyuan sneered, lifted her up, and let her wrap her legs around his waist, "You only have a tough mouth, but your body is much more honest than your mouth."

"That's all you have, you can go to school even if you can't argue, you're a kindergarten graduate?" Wen Yiran gritted his teeth and shot back.

"Continue," Fu Linyuan quickened his pace, "If you say something harsh, I'll do it for ten more minutes. Let's see who gives up first."

Wen Yiran was finally defeated and fell into his arms like a paralyzed person.

Fu Linyuan leaned against the wall, his breathing still not calming down, "Am I cold-blooded?"

Wen Yiran rolled his eyes weakly, "It's hot. It's like a stove, okay? You are the hottest in the world."

"Yin and yang."

"Learned it from you."

Fu Linyuan carried Wen Yiran to the sofa, then turned and went to the bathroom.

The images that had been suppressed in the back of his mind flashed back again.

The girl, wearing a blue and white striped hospital gown, huddled in the corner. When she saw him, she rushed forward and grabbed his shoulders.

His pupils were dilated and his voice was hoarse: "Fuck me quickly...Fuck me..."

The next second she tilted her head suddenly and vomited violently on the ground at his feet.

He slurred in his mouth: "Dirty...so dirty..."

The water from the faucet is still flowing.

Fu Linyuan suddenly came to his senses and found that he was already kneeling in front of the sink.

This time it was just retching and nothing was vomited.

He raised his head and looked into the mirror.
